messages:
alex: FYI CI promo is held up. manylinux wheel link step failing for legacy ffi binding: `ld: undefined symbol: PyInit_ffi` on runner-03.
jen: which matrix? manylinux2014? linux-x86_64?
alex: job build-wheels/manylinux-ffi (x86_64). artifacts not uploaded so promo bot paused.
release-bot: Promotion paused — missing artifact: //bindings:ffi-wheel (manylinux) — check https://ci.redwood.example/build/98765
priya: could be the recent baseimage bump (gcc/glibc) or pybind11 ABI change. we changed the baseimage in main yesterday.
dan: i merged the baseimage bump. i can try a reproduce with the exact image locally.
jen: short options: 1) pin to last-good wheel from storage and manual promote, 2) revert baseimage bump in main, 3) kick off a rebuild with older toolchain variant.
alex: prefer 1 — low blast radius.
priya: agree. pinning is fastest. also file follow-up to fix build and add CI guard.
dan: i'll copy the last-good wheel to staging: `gsutil cp gs://artifacts/wheels/ffi-2.0.1-manylinux.whl gs://staging/wheels/` then update release-manifest.
jen: i'll update release-manifest.yaml: `bindings/ffi: version: "2.0.1"  # pinned to last-good wheel` and request manual promote.
release-bot: Manual promote requested by jen — run-id 7621. Canary: us-east-1 small fleet.
ops: note: change window opens in 30m. if canary passes we can cut the hotfix inside the window.
alex: ensure changelog includes a short note about the temporary pin and follow-up issue.
priya: adding GH issue infra/ffi-abi with logs and reproducer, assigning to dan.
dan: canary smoke looks OK so far (install, unit smoke). running integration stress now.
jen: can you paste the failing linker logs here? might help triage.
dan: snippet: `gcc -shared -o _ffi.cpython-39-x86_64-linux-gnu.so _ffi.o -L... -lpython3.9` then `ld: /usr/lib/...: undefined symbol: PyInit_ffi`
priya: that suggests module init name mismatch or compiled against wrong python minor. check PYTHON_ABI flags.
alex: regardless, proceed with pin. jen — did promote finish?
jen: promote completed — canary passed. :white_check_mark:
release-bot: Promotion complete — hotfix/2026-03-21-ffi-pin released to production.
ops: rolling increase logging and retention for the next 72h to monitor.
priya: created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/1204 assigned to dan. label: infra/ffi, priority: p1.
dan: i'll try build with older toolchain variant and then add a CI matrix job to catch future baseimage bumps.
alex: release notes draft: "Hotfix: pinned legacy FFI wheel to 2.0.1 due to manylinux linker failure after toolchain bump. Follow-up: investigate ABI/toolchain mismatch; revert pin once resolved."
jen: notes added to changelog, publishing release candidate now. thanks all.
alex: closing thread.
